{{Top|leg}}
A '''barge driver''' was a specialized bulk [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] used to haul large amounts of cargo across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Barge drivers generally consisted of a [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] and living quarters connected to a separate [[Engine/Legends|engineering]] section by a narrow boom, with a space beneath in which a large modular [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo container]] could be attached, allowing ships of this type to collect and off-load freight very rapidly. The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[BD-27 Transport]] was one type of barge driver active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
